name: Fremont Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: You raise issues that matter to teens and pass them to the City Council. You also help plan forums and workshops for other teens.
who_can_apply: The page does not state ages, grades or residency rules. Ask the Recreation Division.
deadline_text: Apply any time; applications expire Dec 31.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application form on the commission page. It asks why you want to serve and has three more short questions. Questions: Alyssa Hashimoto, 510-790-5520.
notes: Meets 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. on the first Monday of each month except July and August, at City Hall, 3300 Capitol Ave. The page lists 13 members.
